info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Combination Management API
info.description: The Product Combination Management API enables businesses to update existing product combinations offered within their banking services. By utilizing this API, clients can modify the features or terms of specific product combinations to better meet customer needs. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers working on banking applications that require dynamic product offerings. This API supports seamless updates, ensuring that the latest product combinations are available for customers.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the specified product combination. Ensure to provide the correct data to reflect the necessary changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product combination with the specified ID. It allows for partial updates to the properties of the product combination. The request must include a JSON payload that aligns with the defined schema, enabling clients to modify specific fields as needed.
